# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Compliance — Apps

> 37 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Compliance under Apps. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Apps

- [Artifacts](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/artifacts.md): Artifact ID e.g. 'claude_artifact_abc123'
- [Attachments](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/projects/attachments.md): List files and documents attached to a project.
- [Chats](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/chats.md): Pagination cursor for retrieving the next page of results. To paginate, pass the `last_id` value from the most recent response.
- [Collaborators](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/projects/collaborators.md): List the users, groups, and organization-wide grants on a project.
- [Delete chat](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/chats/delete.md): The ID of the Claude chat that was deleted
- [Delete file](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/chats/files/delete.md): Permanently deletes a specific file. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.
- [Delete project](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/projects/delete.md): The ID of the Claude project that was deleted
- [Delete project document](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/projects/documents/delete.md): The ID of the project document that was deleted
- [Documents](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/projects/documents.md): The ID of the project document that was deleted
- [Download a Claude-generated file](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/chats/generated_files/download.md): Downloads the binary content of a file the assistant created via tool use.
- [Download artifact content](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/artifacts/download.md): Download the content of an artifact version for compliance purposes.
- [Download file content](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/chats/files/download.md): Downloads the binary content of a file referenced in chat messages.
- [Files](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/chats/files.md): Retrieves metadata for a file referenced in chat messages, without downloading the file content. Use the sibling `/content` endpoint to download the bytes.
- [Generated Files](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/chats/generated_files.md): Opaque generated-file id, e.g. 'claude_gen_file_abc123'.
- [Get artifact metadata](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/artifacts/retrieve.md): Artifact ID e.g. 'claude_artifact_abc123'
- [Get chat messages](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/chats/messages/list.md): Pagination cursor for retrieving the next page of results. To paginate, pass the `last_id` value from the most recent response.
- [Get Claude-generated file metadata](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/chats/generated_files/retrieve.md): Opaque generated-file id, e.g. 'claude_gen_file_abc123'.
- [Get file metadata](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/chats/files/retrieve.md): Retrieves metadata for a file referenced in chat messages, without downloading the file content. Use the sibling `/content` endpoint to download the bytes.
- [Get project details](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/projects/retrieve.md): Get detailed information for a specific project.
- [Get project document content](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/projects/documents/retrieve.md): Get detailed information for a specific project document.
- [Get project document metadata](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/projects/documents/metadata.md): Returns metadata for a project document, without the content body.
- [List chats](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/chats/list.md): Pagination cursor for retrieving the next page of results. To paginate, pass the `last_id` value from the most recent response.
- [List local sessions](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/sessions/local/list.md): Page of local sessions, ordered by `created_at` descending; ties are broken by a fixed server-side order.
- [List project attachments](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/projects/attachments/list.md): List files and documents attached to a project.
- [List project collaborators](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/projects/collaborators/list.md): List the users, groups, and organization-wide grants on a project.
- [List projects](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/projects/list.md): List of projects sorted by creation date ascending
- [List remote sessions](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/sessions/remote/list.md): List remote sessions (Cowork sessions that run in Anthropic-managed cloud environments) across the organizations the key may read.
- [Local](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/sessions/local.md): Page of local sessions, ordered by `created_at` descending; ties are broken by a fixed server-side order.
- [Messages](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/chats/messages.md): Pagination cursor for retrieving the next page of results. To paginate, pass the `last_id` value from the most recent response.
- [Messages](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/sessions/local/messages.md): Maximum results (default: 100, max: 1000)
- [Messages](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/sessions/remote/messages.md): Maximum results (default: 100, max: 1000)
- [Projects](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/projects.md): List of projects sorted by creation date ascending
- [Remote](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/sessions/remote.md): List remote sessions (Cowork sessions that run in Anthropic-managed cloud environments) across the organizations the key may read.
- [Retrieve a local session](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/sessions/local/retrieve.md): Local session identifier, prefixed `clls_`. Unique within the parent organization.
- [Retrieve local session messages](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/sessions/local/messages/list.md): Maximum results (default: 100, max: 1000)
- [Retrieve remote session messages](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/sessions/remote/messages/list.md): Maximum results (default: 100, max: 1000)
- [Sessions](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/apps/sessions.md): List local sessions across the organizations the key may read.
